front: Khái niệm 'Future Predictions with 'Will'' trong Unit 6: Weather Forecasts, Seasons & Directions được hiểu như thế nào?
back:
Subject + will + Verb (bare infinitive). Used to predict future events, especially weather forecasts.

💡 Ví dụ: 'What will the weather be like tomorrow?' - 'It will be cold and stormy.'
🌱 Bản chất: Simple future modal verb expressing expectations about tomorrow.

front: Khái niệm 'Transforming Nouns into Weather Adjectives' trong Unit 6: Weather Forecasts, Seasons & Directions được hiểu như thế nào?
back:
Add -y to weather nouns: sun -> sunny; rain -> rainy; wind -> windy; cloud -> cloudy; fog -> foggy.

💡 Ví dụ: There is a lot of rain today -> Today is a rainy day.
🌱 Bản chất: Notice the double consonant: sun -> sunny; fog -> foggy.

front: Quy tắc / Công thức quan trọng: 'Answering 'What is your favourite season?''?
back:
S + like / love + season + because it is + weather adjective.

📝 Ví dụ: I like autumn because it is cool and windy.
🔑 Ý nghĩa: Always give a sensory reason explaining your weather preference.

front: Phương pháp giải bài toán: 'Reorder the words to make a sentence: 'will / in / like / What / Hanoi / be / the / tomorrow / weather / ?''?
back:
Các bước giải chi tiết:
Bước 1: Từ để hỏi: 'What'.
Bước 2: Trợ động từ tương lai: 'will'.
Bước 3: Cụm chủ ngữ: 'the weather in Hanoi'.
Bước 4: Động từ và từ nối: 'be like tomorrow?'.
Bước 5: Ghép lại: 'What will the weather be like in Hanoi tomorrow?'

👉 Kết luận: What will the weather be like in Hanoi tomorrow?

front: Bẫy sai lầm cần tránh: Writing 'It will is cold' instead of 'It will be cold'.?
back:
❌ Lỗi sai: Writing 'It will is cold' instead of 'It will be cold'.

💡 Nguyên nhân & Khắc phục: After 'will', the verb must be in base form (bare infinitive): 'be'.
